content.name: Anika Sharma
content.title: Senior Financial Analyst
content.summary: Financial analyst with eight years in insurance, grocery retail and renewable energy, and a CFA Level II pass. Models project returns for a 1.4 GW wind and solar pipeline and built the financing model that supported a $310 million project loan.

experience.title: Senior Financial Analyst
bullets: Maintain project finance models for 12 wind and solar projects totalling 1.4 GW, from development through commercial operation.
Built the base-case and lender sensitivity model for a $310 million construction loan that closed in 2024.
Analyze power purchase agreement bids, showing the effect of price escalators and curtailment on equity returns.
Mentor a junior analyst on model review and audit trails.

experience.title: Financial Analyst
bullets: Produced weekly sales and margin reporting for 86 stores and the executive team.
Ran shrink analysis by category that cut produce write-offs by 12% in the pilot region.
Supported capital requests for 14 store renovations, tracking actual payback against the approved business cases.
Built a labour-cost forecast tied to sales per hour, adopted by district managers for scheduling.

experience.title: Financial Analyst, Actuarial Finance
bullets: Reconciled reserve movements each quarter for a $2.1 billion property and casualty book.
Prepared IFRS 17 transition data extracts and documented assumptions for the project team.
Replaced manual claims-ratio reports with a SQL and Excel process that ran in minutes instead of hours.

education.school: Queen's University, Smith School of Business

achievements.title: $310M loan closed
achievements.detail: Built the lender model for Northshore's largest construction financing.
